description: D K Shivakumar told industry leaders Karnataka will build an AI University and expand tech infrastructure beyond Bengaluru. The push signals a broader strategy to spread investment, talent and digital growth across the state.
body_lead: Karnataka to set up AI University, to roll out tech expansion policy in 100 days Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar told industry leaders that his government will build an AI University and expand tech infrastructure beyond Bengaluru within 100 days. The push signals a broader strategy to spread investment, talent and digital growth across the state.
